title: Stompworks, A small books worth of prompts in about a week.
author: crumbaker
selftext:
Cel-shaded fully customizable mechs. Buy the right parts, take out the enemies, and don't die. 18 torsos, 14 sets of legs and 27 weapons. Mostly finished, and hope ya'll dig it.

This was a lot of fun to make, I think the key is to build everything in small steps, and mix up prompts between bug fixes and features.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383780/Stompworks/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383780/Stompworks/?beta=0)

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body: looks awesome I love the artstyle it's like borderlands art with mechs. mind sharing your workflow

replies.author: crumbaker
replies.body: Thank you. I wish there was more to share just basically explained everything I wanted in small stages. Basic mechs, then a single stage, then menus. All in separate prompts. I think that's the key not bogging the ai down with too much with each prompt. Then switching to a bug fix, features, bug fix, features, pattern. No mcp's needed.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body: nice what model and game engine or framework are you using. You did a great job form what I can see. Are you going to enter it in a steam next fest demo to get some Wishlist's before release. It looks fun

replies.author: crumbaker
replies.body: I didn't make it in time for Nextfest but plan on having a demo very soon. It's using three.js
